jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - German Market 🇩🇪
jobs.descriptionHtml:
• Our mission and customers: We are building a friendly finance workspace for small businesses, with everyday banking at its core and simple tools around it. Customers rate us 4.7 out of 5 on a fictional review site (https://reviews.example/cobaltledger). Our culture (https://example.com/cobaltledger/culture) puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, and we are proud of the people behind it.

  • Your role: You join a small team that owns a slice of the product from idea to production. You work with designers and product managers, review code and keep quality high.

  • Your profile: You enjoy clear communication, honest estimates and learning from mistakes. You have solid professional experience in your area and speak fluent English.

  • Hiring process: a short intro call, a take-home exercise, a technical conversation and a final chat with the team lead (https://example.com/cobaltledger/team). We reply to every candidate.

  • Benefits: flexible hours, a learning budget, private health insurance and a yearly team meeting. This is a made-up posting used only for tests.
